summary.text: The story takes place on Alara, where the Conflux has merged the five shards, so that Bant castles, Jund tar pits and Grixis armies now spill over into Naya and the other lands.

It follows people caught in the collision, from Mayael trying to hold borders that no longer exist to refugees fleeing Thraximundar's undead, while Nicol Bolas, whose plans reach their zenith as the shards merge, is revealed as the pale boy who opens a rift in Antoris City's spell-wall.
Across the rejoined plane, creatures are taken from one shard to fight in another and people must make hard choices that decide their fates in the inter-shard war.
